_README: SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT FIXTURE. Values are hand-written approximations of publicly reported magnitudes (PBE band gaps, hull distances, DFPT dielectric constants, literature counts) chosen to exercise the pipeline: known workhorses, gate failures, missing dielectric data, cross-source disagreement, hazardous elements, hygroscopic oxides. Material ids are fx-NNNN and never correspond to Materials Project ids. Do not use for real triage; build the real cache with `oxide-triage warm-cache`. Elasticity blocks (bulk and shear moduli, the Clarke and Cahill minimum thermal conductivities, the Debye temperature) are approximations of the Materials Project elastic-tensor records for the thermal-barrier profile; two carry the source's own warnings so a flagged record can be exercised. The `thermo` map holds, per element system plus Si (and plus Al for the thermal-barrier profile's alumina substrate), the stable phases and their formation energies from Materials Project (GGA_GGA+U_R2SCAN, fetched 2026-09-10) so the interface criterion has a real hull to work from; it is the only part of the fixture that is not hand-written.
